rv.q: It’s like hearing the opera the way you always imagined it.
Her performance was beyond impeccable in its musical and dramatic qualities.
Focus and stamina were the hallmarks of her performance in a role that is onstage front and center for most of the opera’s two and a half hours.

cn.t: The Met's visually stunning production of Puccini's tragedy wins praise for its striking minimalist design and Bunraku puppetry, with Ailyn Pérez earning acclaim for her triumphant performance in the demanding title role.
